newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy unit accepts rate settlement.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy unit accepts rate settlement.

text.p: Consumers Power Co, the principal subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp, said Tuesday it will accept an electric rate settlement approved with modifications on November 14 by the Michigan Public Service Commission.

The settlement resolves three pending cases before the commission -- Consumers Power's general electric rate case, its request for approval of a special competitive services tariff and the utility's application for approval of revised electric and common utility plant depreciation rates
A proposed settlement resolving the three cases had been filed by the utility and commission staff on September 8, 1995.
The commission's approval of the settlement was contingent on the utility's acceptance of the modifications included in the November 14 order.
Consumers Power is Michigan's largest utility providing natural gas and electricity to more than six million residents.
